company.description:
Established in 1869, Bogawantalawa Teas has achieved a distinguished position as the world’s first tea growing, manufacturing, and marketing company to offer Climate Positive Teas, certified for 100% renewables. Nestled in the iconic Golden Valley of Ceylon Tea, renowned for producing the richest and finest quality tealeaf, our plantations span 16,000 hectares across 11 estates.

 

Our diverse range of teas, available in flavoured, herbal, and bulk forms, provides customers with the unparalleled experience of 'Garden Fresh Pure Ceylon Tea'. As a leading name in the tea industry, BPL Teas (Pvt) Ltd. excels in marketing a wide variety of Black and Green Teas in packets and tea bags, as well as catering to premium and gift

Our range of teas are available in flavoured, herbal, and bulk forms offering our customers the opportunity of experiencing 'Garden Fresh Pure Ceylon Tea'​. BPL Teas (Pvt) Ltd.  We are experienced in marketing a wide range of Black Tea and Green Tea in packets and Tea Bags, while catering to premium and gift tea requirements, in parallel.

Bogawantalawa is a trusted private label partner of choice for several prestigious global supermarket chains and re-distributors. They work with us because of our quality philosophy of offering the best teas manufactured under stringent hygienic conditions.

Our estates, factories and processing plants bear testaments to this philosophy has received the following international certifications for quality assurance, quality control, origin traceability, and food hygiene systems.

# HACCP Certifications.
# BRC Food Certification.
# ISO 9001:2008 System Certification.
# ISO 22000:2005 System Certification.
# Fairtrade Certification.

Bogawantalawa is one of the world's most awarded tea export companies and has secured numerous awards. (Best Iced Tea Award continuously since 2004 and during the year 2005 we were awarded the Best Chai Iced Tea and Best Flavoured Iced Tea Awards at the World tea Expo exhibition in USA).

A journey through the Golden Valley of Ceylon.
 
During his visits to Sri Lanka, Bogawantalawa's Brand Ambassador for the Europe region, Stijn Van Schoonlandt, spent time across our estates to experience the people, places and processes behind 150 years of tea making.
 
His journey took him to the estates of the Golden Valley of Ceylon including Bogawantalawa, Bogawana, Kotiyagalla, Norwood, Loinorn, Wanarajah and Fettresso, where he experienced the growing conditions, cultivation and harvesting methods, tea manufacturing process, specialty teas that unique to Bogawantalawa Teas and what make us stands out among others. 
 
With a deeper understanding of Bogawantalawa Teas from source to cup, combined with his extensive tea knowledge, this marks the beginning of a long and meaningful partnership, creating new opportunities to share our heritage, craftsmanship and exceptional teas with tea enthusiasts throughout the region.
 
Robin Winter MBA (UK)DIP(NIPM) General Manager - Bogawana Estate, Mr. Nalinda De Alwis General Manager – Kotiyagalla Estate, Mr. Lasitha De Silva General Manager – Norwood Estate, Mr. Manoj Ramdas Dept. During his visit to the Bogawantalawa Estates, the Brand Ambassador for the Europe region, Stijn Van Schoonlandt, was invited to do more than experience our specialty teas. He became part of the legacy, giving a name to a tea whose story had waited generations to be told.
 
This signature specialty tea comes from the Manickawatta Division. Originating from seedling tea bushes first planted in the late 1800s, this signature tea remained unnoticed for generations before being rediscovered and carefully brought back to life by the skilled hands of the Wanarajah Estate tea makers.
 
Invited by Zaman Imthiaz  MBA(UK), LSSBB, PMP, DIP(PM), FIPM General Manager of Wanarajah Estate to name the tea, Mr. Stijn saw more than a cup of tea. With his passion for storytelling, he connected its journey, a rare tea, hidden by time, born in a land known for its precious gems.  
 
And so, it found its name.

Lost Gem.
 
A name that honours not only the tea itself, but also the history beneath the soil.

On the invitation of His Excellency Omar Lebbe Ameer Ajwad, Ambassador of Sri Lanka to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Bogawantalawa Teas paid a courtesy visit at the Embassy of Sri Lanka in Riyadh.

Representing Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon were Almas Marikkar, Director and Chief Executive Officer, Anne Ranasinghe, Manager - Customer and Market Development, Middle East Region and Kabeer Tharick, Assistant Manager – Product Innovation and Infusions.  

The meeting provided a valuable opportunity to discuss strengthening Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia trade relations through the continued growth of Ceylon Tea exports, while exploring opportunities to enhance the presence of the world's first climate positive teas in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.  

The exchange also highlighted Bogawantalawa Teas continued expansion into organically cultivated herbs and spices, including vanilla, ginger, cinnamon and turmeric, reflecting Sri Lanka's growing capabilities in premium, origin based agricultural products.  

We extend our sincere appreciation to His Excellency for his warm hospitality and valuable insights and look forward to contributing to the continued growth of Sri Lankan tea exports to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.  

#BogawantalawaTeas #CeylonTea #SaudiArabia #Tea #ClimatePositiveTeas #Sustainability

Welcoming an Ambassador to Represent the World's First Climate Positive Teas Across Europe.

Today marks an important milestone in the global journey of Bogawantalawa Tea Ceylon as we officially welcomed Stijn Van Schoonlandt as the Brand Ambassador for Bogawantalawa Teas in the European region, formalized through the signing of a partnership agreement.

A Certified International Tea Master and Tea Blender, entrepreneur, educator, a member of the Board of Directors of the European Specialty Tea Association and Regional Director – Europe of the International Tea Masters Association, Mr. Stijn has earned recognition within the global tea industry for his work in tea education, sensory evaluation and market development.

His experience extends beyond education, having represented tea at international events, collaborated with embassies to promote tea origins and worked closely with tea producers to strengthen their presence in European markets. His ability to combine tea expertise, authentic storytelling, commercial insight and industry relationships makes him a valuable partner as Bogawantalawa continues to grow its footprint across the region.

As the Brand Ambassador in Europe, Mr. Stijn will represent Bogawantalawa Teas at international exhibitions, conduct tea tastings and masterclasses, strengthen relationships with trade partners and share the story behind our teas with consumers and industry professionals. His role will help bring the heritage, craftsmanship and sustainability that define Bogawantalawa Teas to a wider audience across Europe.

The agreement was signed at the Bogawantalawa Tea Processing Centre in the presence of  Almas Marikkar, Director & CEO, Abhishek Ambani, Director of Overseas Operations and Ruvini Senarathna, Manager – Marketing & Brand Development, reflecting our continued commitment to expanding the presence of the world's first climate positive teas across Europe.

The event concluded with an exclusive tea tasting session featuring selections from the Bogawantalawa Luxury Collection, Ceylon Tea Gardens and our Specialty Tea range, offering Mr. Stijn the opportunity to experience the distinct character and craftsmanship behind each collection.

We are delighted to welcome Mr. Stijn Van Schoonlandt to represent Bogawantalawa. His knowledge, passion and extensive network within the global tea community will be instrumental as we continue introducing the world's first climate positive teas from the Golden Valley of Ceylon to discerning consumers across Europe.
